name: 2C-T-27
summary: 2C-T-27, also known as 4-benzylthio-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and 2C families.

pharmacology.text: It showed higher affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor than any other 2C drug (Ki = 1.6 nM), but its activational potency and efficacy were among the lowest (EC50 = 26 nM; Emax = 27%). The drug produces the head-twitch response (HTR), a behavioral proxy of psychedelic effects, in rodents. However, the HTR induced by 2C-T-27 is relatively weak.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: 2C-T-27 has been reported to produce hallucinogenic effects in humans.
